summary: International Media Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a $2,000 deposit into its trust account to extend the deadline for completing an initial business combination from May 2, 2026 to June 2, 2026. This is the 17th of 24 permitted monthly extensions under the trust agreement. No transaction terms, premium, or board recommendation are provided. The filing is a routine SPAC extension notice, not a special situation such as a merger announcement, termination, or liquidation. As a procedural update, it does not constitute an actionable special situation.
